# The AI for Sales Podcast

> The AI for Sales Podcast, hosted by best-selling author and sales innovator Chad Burmeister, covers how revenue teams use artificial intelligence to sell more in less time: AI SDRs, prospecting automation, pipeline generation, and go-to-market strategy. Tagline: "In sales, time kills deals. In AI for Sales, AI kills time." New episodes every Saturday. Ranked #2 podcast for AI for Sales.

## Key facts

- Host: Chad Burmeister — best-selling author, keynote speaker, and founder (BDR.ai / SDR.ai). Personal site: https://www.chadburmeister.com/
- Format: interview podcast with operators and executives building AI for sales (recent guests from Salesforce Agentforce, Nooks, ZoomInfo, Nue, Onfire.ai)
- Cadence: 1 new episode per week, published Saturdays
- Audience: B2B sales leaders, SDR/BDR teams, revenue operations
- Sponsors/partners: BDR.ai, Nooks.ai, ZoomInfo
- Contact: chad@sdr.ai
